summary: The school district urges the FCC to preserve the E-Rate program, emphasizing the essential role of broadband connectivity in modern education and the potential budgetary and infrastructure impacts of eliminating it. The school district urges the FCC to protect the E-Rate program and reject proposals to sunset or eliminate it, emphasizing its importance for providing reliable broadband to schools and libraries.
filer_raw: Dr. Josh Patterson, Beaverhead County High School District, Dillon, Montana
